name: Barbican Centre
type: theatre building; art museum; concert hall; performing arts center
text: The Barbican Centre is a performing arts centre in the Barbican Estate in the City of London. The centre hosts classical and contemporary music concerts, theatre performances, film screenings and art exhibitions. It also houses a library, three restaurants, and a conservatory.
